name: Ironjaw Enforcer's Full Combat Street Kit
description: Matte-black segmented trauma armor worn over a tight gunmetal compression underlayer, paired with reinforced thigh-pocket cargo pants in charcoal ripstop and mag-lace combat boots with ankle-plate inserts. The shoulder and forearm armor panels are aug-compatible with full chrome-arm clearance channels, and the back panel has a reinforced spinal rig slot. It reads as private security from a distance — up close, the lack of any corporate logo says otherwise.
functionality: Trauma-rated armor panels with aug-compatible chrome-arm channels and spinal rig slot; mag-lace boots allow single-pull emergency boot removal.
what_it_says: This person is the last warning before things become irreversible.
story_hooks: The armor bears a barely-sanded-off logo from a now-dissolved corporate security firm — someone knows exactly who this person used to work for.
The spinal rig slot contains a kill-switch override chip that the wearer's employer installed without telling them.
